This section is adapted from the generalized linear model part of the Newton's method lecture of @zhou2025newton,
used under the MIT License.

The source writes the logistic [score](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) and information, notes that Newton's method and [Fisher scoring](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-fisher-scoring) coincide, and rewrites the step as a weighted least squares fit.
Here the step is stated as a theorem and proved, with the step length fixed at $1$.
The example, using the six-patient trial, is new.
The source's treatment of general generalized linear models, Gauss-Newton and Levenberg-Marquardt is not part of this section.
The general optimization methods behind [IRLS](#def-irls) are on the [Optimization](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/optimization.html) page of the math notes.
